NONE: › in or towards the back part of a boat
在船尾（的）；向船尾（的）
A1 following in time, place, or order
（時間、地點或順序）在…之後；（一個）接著（一個）
A2 later than someone or something else
以後，後來；向後；在後面
B1 at a time that is later than another event
在…之後
› coming after
…之後的
› to be looking for someone or something or trying to find or get him, her, or it
尋找；追求；追捕
› used to say politely that someone can go in front of you or serve themselves with food before you
（用於讓別人先走或先用飲食）你先請
› typical of or similar to the style of
具有…風格；模仿…
C2 used when giving someone or something the same name as another person or thing
依照…命名

example: Let's go for a walk after breakfast.
我們吃過早餐去散步吧。
Some people believe in life after death.
一些人相信死後靈魂依然存在。
Her name came after mine on the list.
名單上她的名字排在我後面。
There's a good film on the day after tomorrow.
後天有一部不錯的電影。
She waited until well after midnight.
她一直等到深夜很晚的時候。
US It's a quarter after four.
四點十五分了。
She just keeps on working, day after day, week after week (= continuously).
她日復一日地工作下去。
We've had meeting after meeting (= many meetings) to discuss this point.
我們一次又一次地開會討論這個問題。
Jessie seemed very small after (= in comparison with) Michael's children.
與麥克的孩子比起來，傑西顯得很矮小。
After (= despite) everything I've done for you, is this the way you treat me?
我甚麼都為你做了，你就這樣對待我嗎？
After (= because of) what she did to me, I'll never trust her again.
她對我做出這種事情，我再也不會信任她了。
The children have to learn to tidy up after themselves (= after they have made things untidy).
孩子必須意識到，自己弄亂了東西，就得自己收拾整齊。
She slammed the door after (= behind) her.
她隨手砰地關上了門。
We ran after (= followed) him, but he escaped.
我們去追他，但是他逃脫了。
Could you lock up after you (= when you leave), please?
請你離開時鎖好門好嗎？
The police are after him.
警方正在追捕他。
I'm after a tie to go with this shirt.
我要找一條和這件襯衫相配的領帶。
I'm sure she's after my husband.
我敢肯定她在打我丈夫的主意。
He's after Jane's job (= wants it for himself).
他想搶簡的工作。
"Can I pour you some coffee?" "Oh no, after you."
「我給你倒點咖啡吧？」「噢，不用，你先來吧。」
a painting after Titian
一幅模仿提香的畫作
a concerto after Mozart
模仿莫札特風格的協奏曲
He was named Mark after his grandfather.
他以祖父的名字命名為馬克。
Hilary got here at midday and Nick arrived soon after.
希拉蕊中午到了這裡，隨後不久尼克也到了。
I can't go next week - how about the week after (= the following week)?
下星期我去不了，下下星期怎麼樣？
not standard She got back at 4.30 and went to see Emilie after (= after she got back).
她四點半回來的，隨後就去探望艾蜜莉了。
Three months after they moved out, the house was still empty.
他們搬出去三個月了，這座房子仍然空著。
Soon/shortly after we set off, the car started to make a strange noise.
我們出發不久，車子就發出奇怪的噪音。
I went to the post office straight/immediately after I left you.
離開你以後我馬上／立刻就去了郵局。
an after-dinner speech
宴會後的講話
an after-hours club
深夜營業的夜總會
after-sales service
售後服務

NONE: C1 despite earlier problems or doubts
終究
B1 used to add information that shows that what you have just said is true
畢竟

example: The rain has stopped, so the game will go ahead after all.
雨已經停了，所以比賽還會繼續下去。
I do like her - after all, she is my sister.
我當然喜歡她，畢竟她是我姐姐呀。

NONE: › after the usual hours of work
工作時間之後，下班後
› If you drink in a bar after hours, you drink alcohol at a time when it is not allowed by law.
在違禁時間，在正常營業時間之外

example: I often do some of my own work after hours.
我經常在下班後做一些自己的事。
The police are trying to stop after-hours drinking.
警方正設法禁止在違禁時間內飲酒。

NONE: › having the same opinions or interests as you
與（某人）觀點（或興趣）相同

example: She's a woman after my own heart.
她是個與我趣味相投的女人。

NONE: › the material, including the placenta, that is pushed out of a woman's or female animal's body soon after she has given birth
胞衣；胎盤及羊膜
› the care of people after they have left a hospital or prison
（病人出院後的）護理；犯人出獄後的安置
› an unpleasant effect that follows an event or accident, sometimes continuing for a long time or happening some time after it
事後影響；餘波；後遺症

example: Headaches are an aftereffect of this sort of accident.
頭痛是這種事故的一種後遺症。

NONE: › a pleasant feeling produced after an experience, event, feeling, etc.
美好的回憶

example: The team were basking in the afterglow of winning the cup.
球隊沉浸在奪杯的喜悅中。

NONE: › the life, for example in heaven, that some people believe begins after death
死後（靈魂）的生活

example: They'll be reunited in the afterlife.
他們將在另一個世界重聚。

NONE: › the period that follows an unpleasant event or accident, and the effects that it causes
（不愉快事件）結束後的一個時期；（不愉快事件的）後果

example: Many more people died in the aftermath of the explosion.
更多的人死於爆炸後的一段時間裡。

NONE: A1 the period that starts at about twelve o'clock or after the meal in the middle of the day and ends at about six o'clock or when the sun goes down
下午，午後
› a friendly way of greeting someone when you meet them in the afternoon
下午好！

example: It was a sunny afternoon.
那是一個陽光明媚的下午。
She works three afternoons a week at the library.
她每週在圖書館工作三個下午。
It was on a Saturday afternoon.
那是在一個星期六的下午。
My baby usually sleeps in the afternoon.
我的寶寶通常在下午睡覺。
Let's go to the park this afternoon.
我們今天下午去公園吧。
I spoke to her yesterday afternoon.
我昨天下午跟她說過話。
She's coming round on Wednesday afternoon.
她將在週三下午到這裡來。
He's been in a bad mood all afternoon.
他整個下午心情都不好。
She likes to have an afternoon nap.
她喜歡在下午小睡一會兒。
We got an early-/mid-/late-afternoon flight.
我們乘坐的是下午一兩／三四／五六點鐘的飛機。
Afternoon, Bob!
下午好，鮑勃！
Compare
good afternoon

NONE: › a small meal eaten in the late afternoon, usually including cake and a cup of tea
（通常包括蛋糕和茶的）午後茶點
› every afternoon or on many afternoons
每天下午；在許多個下午

example: He works afternoons.
他在下午工作。

NONE: › a relaxed social event in which people sit and talk after they have been at a party or nightclub
（在參加派對後或在夜總會玩樂後的）輕鬆社交活動
› to spend time at an afterparty
參加派對後的聚會

example: The hotel has a huge bar that we afterpartied in.
那家飯店有一個大型酒吧，我們參加派對後就在那裡聚會。

NONE: › sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
（餐後的）甜食

example: What's for afters, Dad?
甜點吃甚麼，爸爸？
Synonym
dessert

NONE: › a liquid with a pleasant smell that a man puts on his face after shaving
（剃鬚後用的）鬍後水
› a sudden movement of the earth's surface that often follows an earthquake and is less violent than the first main movement
（地震後的）餘震

example: The initial earthquake was followed by a series of aftershocks.
初震後又發生了一連串的餘震。

NONE: › the taste that a particular food or other substance leaves in your mouth when you have swallowed it
（飲食等在口中留下的）後味，餘味，回味

example: The medicine left an unpleasant aftertaste.
藥服下後在口中留下了一股怪味道。

NONE: › an idea, thought, or plan that was not originally intended but is thought of at a later time
事後想法；事後添加的事物

example: She only asked me to her party as an afterthought.
她原本沒有請我去參加她的聚會，只是後來才想起來的。
The pillars seem to have been added to the entrance as an afterthought.
這些柱子好像是完工後在入口處添加上去的。

NONE: A2 after the time mentioned
過後，以後，後來

example: We had tea, and afterwards we sat in the garden for a while.
我們喝了茶，後來在花園裡坐了一會兒。
They separated, and soon/shortly afterwards Jane left the country.
他們分手了，此後不久簡就離開了這個國家。
